settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamshoots usa el correo de cuenta, sesiones, selfies fuente, selecciones de paquete, instrucciones creativas, resultados generados, pedidos, suscripciones, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y senales tecnicas necesarias para seguridad y fiabilidad.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos solicitados, reservar y liquidar creditos, entregar albumes privados, resolver incidencias, prevenir abuso, mejorar guias de fotos fuente y mostrar el espacio privado correcto despues de iniciar sesion.

3. Fotos privadas

Las subidas y resultados quedan ligados a la cuenta del cliente en aidreamshoots.eu. No se venden como imagenes de stock ni se publican en galerias abiertas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos se procesan con un proveedor conectado. Guardamos referencias de pedido, pago, reservas, devoluciones y suscripcion, no numeros completos de tarjeta. Algunos registros se conservan para soporte, seguridad, cumplimiento y acceso del cliente.

5. Opciones del cliente

Puedes pedir acceso, correccion, eliminacion o revision escribiendo a support@aidreamshoots.eu con el correo de la cuenta y el pedido afectado.

Puedes pedir revision de creditos comprados y no usados cuando no hayan sido reservados, consumidos ni asociados a una generacion completada.

Envia la solicitud con email de cuenta, pedido y motivo. Revisamos pago, historial de creditos y trabajos de fotos antes de decidir.

Los creditos gastados en paquetes entregados normalmente no son reembolsables porque ya se usaron recursos de proveedor, almacenamiento y entrega.

Si un fallo de AIdreamshoots impide la entrega, soporte puede liberar creditos, reintentar el trabajo, entregar creditos de reemplazo o aprobar reembolso tras revision.

settings.subtitle: Cookies para sesion, checkout, seguridad y continuidad de sets en AIdreamshoots.

settings.body:
1. Sesion del estudio

AIdreamshoots usa cookies esenciales y almacenamiento local para mantener acceso, proteger el checkout, recordar el paquete elegido y conservar el avance de pedidos de fotos IA.

2. Senales de fiabilidad

Podemos leer datos tecnicos limitados para detectar fallos de carga, abuso, errores de pago y estado de generacion dentro del estudio.

3. Gestion del navegador

Puedes borrar o bloquear cookies desde tu navegador. Si bloqueas las esenciales, puede fallar el acceso a cuenta, carrito, pago, album o descarga.

4. Soporte

Para dudas sobre cookies del estudio escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu.

settings.body:
1. Elegibilidad

Puedes pedir revision de creditos comprados y no usados cuando no hayan sido reservados, consumidos ni asociados a una generacion completada.

2. Ventana de revision

Envia la solicitud con email de cuenta, pedido y motivo. Revisamos pago, historial de creditos y trabajos de fotos antes de decidir.

3. Creditos usados

Los creditos gastados en paquetes entregados normalmente no son reembolsables porque ya se usaron recursos de proveedor, almacenamiento y entrega.

4. Fallos tecnicos

Si un fallo de AIdreamshoots impide la entrega, soporte puede liberar creditos, reintentar el trabajo, entregar creditos de reemplazo o aprobar reembolso tras revision.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu para facturacion o reembolsos.

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamshoots usa el correo de cuenta, sesiones, selfies fuente, selecciones de paquete, instrucciones creativas, resultados generados, pedidos, suscripciones, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y senales tecnicas necesarias para seguridad y fiabilidad.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos solicitados, reservar y liquidar creditos, entregar albumes privados, resolver incidencias, prevenir abuso, mejorar guias de fotos fuente y mostrar el espacio privado correcto despues de iniciar sesion.

3. Fotos privadas

Las subidas y resultados quedan ligados a la cuenta del cliente en aidreamshoots.eu. No se venden como imagenes de stock ni se publican en galerias abiertas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos se procesan con un proveedor conectado. Guardamos referencias de pedido, pago, reservas, devoluciones y suscripcion, no numeros completos de tarjeta. Algunos registros se conservan para soporte, seguridad, cumplimiento y acceso del cliente.

5. Opciones del cliente

Puedes pedir acceso, correccion, eliminacion o revision escribiendo a support@aidreamshoots.eu con el correo de la cuenta y el pedido afectado.

settings.body:
The Soccer package category helps myDreamshoots customers choose a clear package direction before they spend credits.

When Soccer is the right fit

Use Soccer when Soccer and Sports are the nearest match for the next photo set. If the goal is still vague, start by naming the final use: profile update, creator album, keepsake, announcement, social draft, or a short motion test.

The strongest soccer requests keep the brief and the result aligned. A customer who needs a calm work portrait should not judge the same set by the standards of a dramatic scene package.

What to prepare before choosing it

Prepare clear approved source portraits, then add one cue that belongs to Soccer: light, scene texture, outfit tone, occasion, group size, or card-ready crop. Start with sharp source photos and one style cue that matters most to the package. Treat the source photos as identity evidence first. Style references, outfit notes, fan details, holiday cues, or movement ideas should support the request after the person is already clear.

For a first pass, keep the input set smaller and cleaner than a social camera roll. Use current images, avoid heavy filters, and separate unrelated goals into different private jobs. myDreamshoots can follow a focused brief more reliably than a folder that asks for several looks at once.

How to compare Soccer with nearby choices

Compare soccer against neighboring packages by the job it solves, not by which cover image looks strongest. The table below turns the category into a practical choice before credit cost is confirmed.

Decision pointUse Soccer whenReview after generation
Final useUse Soccer when Sports is the right broad direction and the private album needs the specific look, scene, or keepsake format described by Soccer.Review whether the finished images look like Soccer instead of drifting into a generic Sports album.
source photosPrepare clear approved source portraits, then add one cue that belongs to Soccer: light, scene texture, outfit tone, occasion, group size, or card-ready crop.Check whether the clearest input details carried through the best images.
Category examplesSoccer and SportsKeep the outputs that match the chosen example instead of mixing several directions.
Credit planUse a focused first pass when the style is new.Decide whether the next request should repeat, expand, or change direction.

Credit and private gallery planning

Before the job starts, review the visible credit cost and ask whether the category is carrying the right amount of work. If you only need to test soccer, a smaller request can teach you what works. If the final use is already clear, a broader gallery may be easier to judge because it gives more crops and expressions to compare.

Finished outputs belong in the signed-in private gallery first. Use that space to compare identity, crop, expression, background detail, and whether the package category actually delivered the mood you selected. Download favorites only after separating public-use images from experiments.

Details to review before download

Review whether the finished images look like Soccer instead of drifting into a generic Sports album. Also check small visual details that often decide whether a result is ready for a profile, card, post, or archive: face consistency, hand and hair edges, clothing lines, background distractions, and whether the image still reads well at the crop size where you will use it.

Soccer should be recognizable through visible details such as color, posture, card framing, scene texture, seasonal cues, supporter energy, or private keepsake mood. This is where Soccer becomes more than a menu label. The visible mood should explain why the category was chosen, while the private gallery keeps the customer in control of what stays personal and what becomes a downloaded favorite.

Mistakes to avoid

Avoid asking Soccer to cover several unrelated fan, game-day, premiere, or holiday scenes at once; the narrower theme should make review easier. The fastest way to weaken soccer results is to overload the request with unrelated goals. Do not ask one job to be a professional portrait, a themed album, a restoration pass, and a motion concept at the same time. Keep the category honest, then run a second request when the next direction is different enough to need its own review.

A planning pass before you spend credits

  • Name the exact use for the finished images.
  • Choose the clearest source photos before adding style references.
  • Match the request to Soccer and Sports, not every nearby category.
  • Review credit cost before generation starts.
  • Use the private gallery to compare results before downloading favorites.

Start with Headshot Photo Package, then compare Soccer with nearby categories before generating. The best choice is the one that makes the review criteria obvious before the first image is generated.

Soccer FAQ

Soccer questions usually come down to source quality, scope, credit planning, and whether the finished images match the intended use.

Is Soccer good for a first request?

Yes, if the intended use is clear and the source photos are current, sharp, and permission-safe. If you are testing a dramatic change, start narrower so the first private gallery can show whether the direction deserves a larger credit spend.

How many source photos should I prepare?

Use enough images to show identity, angle, and expression without adding confusion. A small set of clear portraits usually beats a large group of old, filtered, or mixed-purpose images.

When should I choose another category instead?

Choose another category when the review criteria change. If Soccer is being judged by a different use case, style world, or motion need, split the work into a separate private job so credits support a clearer outcome.

Soccer works best when it is treated as a focused planning choice. Prepare the right inputs, review the cost, and let the private gallery show what should happen next.

settings.title: Cookie policy

settings.body: This policy explains the cookies and local storage used on www.mydreamshoots.com for the myDreamshoots AI photo service.
settings.title: How cookies support sign-in, checkout, and private albums.

settings.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. myDreamshoots also uses similar browser storage, such as local storage, to keep the AI photo service secure, usable, and consistent while you move between packages, checkout, your account, and private albums.

2. Essential cookies

Essential cookies support customer sign-in, scoped sessions, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, credit reservation flows, private album access, rate limiting, fraud prevention, and secure admin or customer authentication. These cookies are required for the core service and cannot be switched off inside the site without breaking key features.

3. Preference storage

We may remember practical preferences such as menu state, recently opened workspace views, selected package context, language or display choices if available, and browser-side UI settings. This helps myDreamshoots open the right customer workspace more quickly.

4. Performance and diagnostics

We may collect limited technical signals to understand slow pages, failed requests, broken checkout steps, job submission errors, and account access issues. These signals help us improve route speed, generation reliability, and customer support.

5. Analytics and measurement

If analytics tools are enabled, they may help us understand aggregated usage such as popular package categories, tool discovery, pricing page visits, and conversion paths. Analytics should not be used to sell your uploaded photos or generated images.

6. Payment, email, hosting, and AI providers

Connected providers may set or read cookies or similar identifiers when needed for checkout, anti-fraud checks, email delivery, hosting security, media storage, or AI generation. Their use is limited to providing and protecting the requested service.

7. Your browser controls

You can block, delete, or limit cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, myDreamshoots may not be able to keep you signed in, complete checkout, reserve credits, start generation jobs, or open private albums.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add or remove providers, analytics, checkout methods, or security features. Email support@mydreamshoots.com with cookie or tracking questions.

1. Service audience

myDreamshoots is not directed to children under 13 and is not designed for child account creation. Customers should use the service only if they can lawfully manage an account or have permission from a parent or legal guardian.

2. COPPA-aware handling

The Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) applies to certain online services directed to children under 13 or knowingly collecting personal information from children under 13. myDreamshoots does not knowingly collect account information directly from children under 13. If we learn that child personal information was provided without required consent, we will review and delete or restrict it as appropriate.

3. Photos of minors

Customers must not upload photos of minors unless they are the parent, legal guardian, or otherwise have the legal right and consent to use those images for the requested AI workflow. Minor images should never be used for deceptive, exploitative, unlawful, or unsafe purposes.

4. Parent or guardian requests

A parent or legal guardian may contact us to ask about access, deletion, or restriction of child-related information. We may request verification before acting on a sensitive privacy request.

5. DPDPA requests

California and other U.S. state privacy requests are handled in our DPDPA notice, including access, deletion, correction, opt-out, and appeal requests where applicable.

6. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for children's privacy or COPPA-related questions.

settings.question: Which AI photo tool should I start with?
settings.answer: Start with the tool that matches the final asset you need. Use headshot tools for LinkedIn, resumes, founder bios, and team pages; creator portrait tools for media kits and campaign images; edit tools for cleanup or enhancement; and AI video tools when you want a short motion concept from an approved still image.

settings.question: What source photos work best for AI Video Generation?
settings.answer: Use sharp, recent, well-lit photos where the subject is visible and the intended edit is clear. Avoid screenshots, heavy beauty filters, tiny crops, sunglasses, blurred faces, extreme compression, and any photo you do not own or have permission to process.

settings.question: Can tool results be used for social media or business pages?

settings.question: What should I inspect before downloading or publishing results?

settings.question: How do I choose the best AI image theme for my use case?
settings.answer: Choose by destination and intent. LinkedIn headshots need a cleaner professional look, creator campaigns need expressive crops, seasonal cards need clear holiday context, and business or product images need realistic framing that matches the channel where the image will appear.

settings.question: Which source photos produce the best AI image results?
settings.answer: Use sharp, recent, well-lit photos with visible faces or subjects, natural skin detail, and minimal obstruction. Avoid heavy filters, screenshots, low-resolution crops, copyrighted references, and images of people who have not approved the intended use.

settings.question: Can I use generated AI images on profiles, social media, or business pages?

settings.question: How should I review final AI images before download?
settings.answer: Check face identity, hands, teeth, eyes, text-like marks, background artifacts, clothing details, brand marks, and crop quality. Keep the strongest outputs and avoid using images that could misrepresent a person, location, product, or affiliation.

settings.body:
The Soccer package category helps myDreamshoots customers choose a clear package direction before they spend credits.

When Soccer is the right fit

Use Soccer when Soccer and Sports are the nearest match for the next photo set. If the goal is still vague, start by naming the final use: profile update, creator album, keepsake, announcement, social draft, or a short motion test.

The strongest soccer requests keep the brief and the result aligned. A customer who needs a calm work portrait should not judge the same set by the standards of a dramatic scene package.

What to prepare before choosing it

Prepare clear approved source portraits, then add one cue that belongs to Soccer: light, scene texture, outfit tone, occasion, group size, or card-ready crop. Start with sharp source photos and one style cue that matters most to the package. Treat the source photos as identity evidence first. Style references, outfit notes, fan details, holiday cues, or movement ideas should support the request after the person is already clear.

For a first pass, keep the input set smaller and cleaner than a social camera roll. Use current images, avoid heavy filters, and separate unrelated goals into different private jobs. myDreamshoots can follow a focused brief more reliably than a folder that asks for several looks at once.

How to compare Soccer with nearby choices

Compare soccer against neighboring packages by the job it solves, not by which cover image looks strongest. The table below turns the category into a practical choice before credit cost is confirmed.

Decision pointUse Soccer whenReview after generation
Final useUse Soccer when Sports is the right broad direction and the private album needs the specific look, scene, or keepsake format described by Soccer.Review whether the finished images look like Soccer instead of drifting into a generic Sports album.
source photosPrepare clear approved source portraits, then add one cue that belongs to Soccer: light, scene texture, outfit tone, occasion, group size, or card-ready crop.Check whether the clearest input details carried through the best images.
Category examplesSoccer and SportsKeep the outputs that match the chosen example instead of mixing several directions.
Credit planUse a focused first pass when the style is new.Decide whether the next request should repeat, expand, or change direction.

Credit and private gallery planning

Before the job starts, review the visible credit cost and ask whether the category is carrying the right amount of work. If you only need to test soccer, a smaller request can teach you what works. If the final use is already clear, a broader gallery may be easier to judge because it gives more crops and expressions to compare.

Finished outputs belong in the signed-in private gallery first. Use that space to compare identity, crop, expression, background detail, and whether the package category actually delivered the mood you selected. Download favorites only after separating public-use images from experiments.

Details to review before download

Review whether the finished images look like Soccer instead of drifting into a generic Sports album. Also check small visual details that often decide whether a result is ready for a profile, card, post, or archive: face consistency, hand and hair edges, clothing lines, background distractions, and whether the image still reads well at the crop size where you will use it.

Soccer should be recognizable through visible details such as color, posture, card framing, scene texture, seasonal cues, supporter energy, or private keepsake mood. This is where Soccer becomes more than a menu label. The visible mood should explain why the category was chosen, while the private gallery keeps the customer in control of what stays personal and what becomes a downloaded favorite.

Mistakes to avoid

Avoid asking Soccer to cover several unrelated fan, game-day, premiere, or holiday scenes at once; the narrower theme should make review easier. The fastest way to weaken soccer results is to overload the request with unrelated goals. Do not ask one job to be a professional portrait, a themed album, a restoration pass, and a motion concept at the same time. Keep the category honest, then run a second request when the next direction is different enough to need its own review.

A planning pass before you spend credits

  • Name the exact use for the finished images.
  • Choose the clearest source photos before adding style references.
  • Match the request to Soccer and Sports, not every nearby category.
  • Review credit cost before generation starts.
  • Use the private gallery to compare results before downloading favorites.

Start with Headshot Photo Package, then compare Soccer with nearby categories before generating. The best choice is the one that makes the review criteria obvious before the first image is generated.

Soccer FAQ

Soccer questions usually come down to source quality, scope, credit planning, and whether the finished images match the intended use.

Is Soccer good for a first request?

Yes, if the intended use is clear and the source photos are current, sharp, and permission-safe. If you are testing a dramatic change, start narrower so the first private gallery can show whether the direction deserves a larger credit spend.

How many source photos should I prepare?

Use enough images to show identity, angle, and expression without adding confusion. A small set of clear portraits usually beats a large group of old, filtered, or mixed-purpose images.

When should I choose another category instead?

Choose another category when the review criteria change. If Soccer is being judged by a different use case, style world, or motion need, split the work into a separate private job so credits support a clearer outcome.

Soccer works best when it is treated as a focused planning choice. Prepare the right inputs, review the cost, and let the private gallery show what should happen next.

settings.answer: Prepare clear, permission-safe photos with good lighting, visible faces, and a few angles or expressions. For identity-heavy packages such as AI headshots or portrait photos, a varied source set usually works better than many near-duplicate selfies.

settings.title: Cookie policy

settings.body: This policy explains the cookies and local storage used on www.mydreamshoots.com for the myDreamshoots AI photo service.
settings.title: How cookies support sign-in, checkout, and private albums.

settings.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. myDreamshoots also uses similar browser storage, such as local storage, to keep the AI photo service secure, usable, and consistent while you move between packages, checkout, your account, and private albums.

2. Essential cookies

Essential cookies support customer sign-in, scoped sessions, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, credit reservation flows, private album access, rate limiting, fraud prevention, and secure admin or customer authentication. These cookies are required for the core service and cannot be switched off inside the site without breaking key features.

3. Preference storage

We may remember practical preferences such as menu state, recently opened workspace views, selected package context, language or display choices if available, and browser-side UI settings. This helps myDreamshoots open the right customer workspace more quickly.

4. Performance and diagnostics

We may collect limited technical signals to understand slow pages, failed requests, broken checkout steps, job submission errors, and account access issues. These signals help us improve route speed, generation reliability, and customer support.

5. Analytics and measurement

If analytics tools are enabled, they may help us understand aggregated usage such as popular package categories, tool discovery, pricing page visits, and conversion paths. Analytics should not be used to sell your uploaded photos or generated images.

6. Payment, email, hosting, and AI providers

Connected providers may set or read cookies or similar identifiers when needed for checkout, anti-fraud checks, email delivery, hosting security, media storage, or AI generation. Their use is limited to providing and protecting the requested service.

7. Your browser controls

You can block, delete, or limit cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, myDreamshoots may not be able to keep you signed in, complete checkout, reserve credits, start generation jobs, or open private albums.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add or remove providers, analytics, checkout methods, or security features. Email support@mydreamshoots.com with cookie or tracking questions.

1. Service audience

myDreamshoots is not directed to children under 13 and is not designed for child account creation. Customers should use the service only if they can lawfully manage an account or have permission from a parent or legal guardian.

2. COPPA-aware handling

The Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) applies to certain online services directed to children under 13 or knowingly collecting personal information from children under 13. myDreamshoots does not knowingly collect account information directly from children under 13. If we learn that child personal information was provided without required consent, we will review and delete or restrict it as appropriate.

3. Photos of minors

Customers must not upload photos of minors unless they are the parent, legal guardian, or otherwise have the legal right and consent to use those images for the requested AI workflow. Minor images should never be used for deceptive, exploitative, unlawful, or unsafe purposes.

4. Parent or guardian requests

A parent or legal guardian may contact us to ask about access, deletion, or restriction of child-related information. We may request verification before acting on a sensitive privacy request.

5. DPDPA requests

California and other U.S. state privacy requests are handled in our DPDPA notice, including access, deletion, correction, opt-out, and appeal requests where applicable.

6. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for children's privacy or COPPA-related questions.

settings.answer: Choose a plan by the number of private AI photo sets you expect to create each month. A light plan can fit occasional AI headshots or profile photos, while higher-credit plans are better for portrait photos, seasonal albums, product lifestyle images, fan photos, and Motion Generator that need more generation attempts.

settings.question: What are credits and when are they charged?
settings.answer: Credits are the account balance used for paid AI generation. myDreamshoots shows the credit cost before a package, AI headshot generator, image editing tool, or video workflow starts; credits are reserved during processing and settled only according to the recorded request status.

settings.question: Can I buy extra credits without changing my subscription?
settings.answer: When one-time top-ups are available, they add extra generation capacity to the same private customer account without replacing the active plan. The checkout screen shows the current top-up amount, credit quantity, currency, and payment terms before purchase.

settings.question: Does pricing include private galleries and downloads?
settings.answer: Paid requests are connected to the signed-in workspace, so finished images or clips can be reviewed from a private gallery before download. Pricing is designed around visible credits, private delivery, and repeatable album organization rather than a public feed of generated images.

settings.question: What happens if a paid AI generation fails?
settings.answer: If a provider request fails or is interrupted before delivery, the platform records the job status and can release reserved credits according to that status. Keep the order, credit, or job reference when contacting support about a failed generation, duplicate charge, or missing gallery result.

settings.question: Where should I check cancellation, refund, and renewal details?
settings.answer: Use the live checkout, account workspace, Terms of Service, and Refund Policy for the current subscription, renewal, cancellation, refund, and credit rules. Promotional pricing and plan contents can change, so the pricing page and checkout confirmation are the source of truth before payment.

settings.question: Which AI photo tool should I start with?
settings.answer: Start with the tool that matches the final asset you need. Use headshot tools for LinkedIn, resumes, founder bios, and team pages; creator portrait tools for media kits and campaign images; edit tools for cleanup or enhancement; and AI video tools when you want a short motion concept from an approved still image.

settings.question: What source photos work best for AI Video Generation?
settings.answer: Use sharp, recent, well-lit photos where the subject is visible and the intended edit is clear. Avoid screenshots, heavy beauty filters, tiny crops, sunglasses, blurred faces, extreme compression, and any photo you do not own or have permission to process.

settings.question: Do myDreamshoots tools use a private upload flow?
settings.answer: Yes. Customer-facing AI Video Generation keep source photos, request settings, credit reservations, generation status, and finished images connected to the signed-in myDreamshoots workspace instead of publishing them publicly by default.

settings.question: How are credits shown for AI photo and video tools?
settings.answer: Paid tools show the credit requirement before generation begins, so you can compare an AI headshot, background edit, image enhancement, portrait style, or AI video request before credits are reserved. Failed requests can release reserved credits according to the recorded job status.

settings.question: Can tool results be used for social media or business pages?
settings.answer: You can use suitable results for social media, creator pages, LinkedIn, websites, ad drafts, or business profiles when you control the source photos, every person shown has approved the use, and the destination platform rules and AI disclosure requirements are followed.

settings.question: What should I inspect before downloading or publishing results?
settings.answer: Review identity details, facial consistency, hands, text-like marks, logos, background artifacts, crop quality, and overall realism. AI results should be checked before use in professional profiles, campaigns, printed material, or customer-facing business pages.

settings.question: Which source photos help a tool perform well?
settings.answer: Use clear, recent, well-lit photos or references you own or have permission to process. A strong upload usually shows the subject, face, product, outfit, or scene without heavy filters, tiny crops, screenshots, blur, sunglasses, or confusing background clutter.

settings.question: How do prompts and settings affect tool results?
settings.answer: Short, specific direction works better than vague requests. Mention the intended channel, crop, mood, background, outfit, or motion goal when the tool supports it, then avoid requests involving unauthorized people, protected logos, official marks, or misleading affiliations.

settings.question: How are credits handled for paid tool requests?
settings.answer: Supported tools show the credit requirement before generation starts. Credits can be reserved while the request runs, then settled or released according to the recorded job status, so customers can compare tools before starting a paid request.

settings.question: Where do generated tool results appear?
settings.answer: Finished images or clips stay connected to the signed-in myDreamshoots workspace or private gallery for review, download, and account history. Results are not public by default, but customers still control anything they download or share outside the workspace.

settings.question: What quality checks matter before publishing?
settings.answer: Review face consistency, hands, eyes, teeth, text-like marks, logos, background artifacts, crop quality, and any motion issues before using outputs on LinkedIn, creator profiles, websites, ads, printed material, or social media.

settings.question: How do I choose the best AI image theme for my use case?
settings.answer: Choose by destination and intent. LinkedIn headshots need a cleaner professional look, creator campaigns need expressive crops, seasonal cards need clear holiday context, and business or product images need realistic framing that matches the channel where the image will appear.

settings.question: Which source photos produce the best AI image results?
settings.answer: Use sharp, recent, well-lit photos with visible faces or subjects, natural skin detail, and minimal obstruction. Avoid heavy filters, screenshots, low-resolution crops, copyrighted references, and images of people who have not approved the intended use.

settings.question: Are AI image results private by default?
settings.answer: Generated image requests are tied to the signed-in myDreamshoots account and delivered through the private workspace or gallery. The images are not treated as a public portfolio by default, but privacy also depends on what you choose to download and share.

settings.question: Can I use generated AI images on profiles, social media, or business pages?
settings.answer: You can use suitable results when you control the source material, have permission from every person shown, follow platform rules, and include any required AI disclosure. Review commercial claims, endorsements, logos, and sensitive contexts before publishing.

settings.question: How should I review final AI images before download?
settings.answer: Check face identity, hands, teeth, eyes, text-like marks, background artifacts, clothing details, brand marks, and crop quality. Keep the strongest outputs and avoid using images that could misrepresent a person, location, product, or affiliation.

The World Cup Fan Photos package category helps myDreamshoots customers choose a clear package direction before they spend credits.

When World Cup Fan Photos is the right fit

Use World Cup Fan Photos when World Cup Fan Photos and Sports are the nearest match for the next photo set. If the goal is still vague, start by naming the final use: profile update, creator album, keepsake, announcement, social draft, or a short motion test.

The strongest world cup fan photos requests keep the brief and the result aligned. A customer who needs a calm work portrait should not judge the same set by the standards of a dramatic scene package.

What to prepare before choosing it

Prepare clear approved source portraits, then add one cue that belongs to World Cup Fan Photos: light, scene texture, outfit tone, occasion, group size, or card-ready crop. Start with sharp source photos and one style cue that matters most to the package. Treat the source photos as identity evidence first. Style references, outfit notes, fan details, holiday cues, or movement ideas should support the request after the person is already clear.

For a first pass, keep the input set smaller and cleaner than a social camera roll. Use current images, avoid heavy filters, and separate unrelated goals into different private jobs. myDreamshoots can follow a focused brief more reliably than a folder that asks for several looks at once.

Before the job starts, review the visible credit cost and ask whether the category is carrying the right amount of work. If you only need to test world cup fan photos, a smaller request can teach you what works. If the final use is already clear, a broader gallery may be easier to judge because it gives more crops and expressions to compare.

Finished outputs belong in the signed-in private gallery first. Use that space to compare identity, crop, expression, background detail, and whether the package category actually delivered the mood you selected. Download favorites only after separating public-use images from experiments.

Details to review before download

Review whether the finished images look like World Cup Fan Photos instead of drifting into a generic Sports album. Also check small visual details that often decide whether a result is ready for a profile, card, post, or archive: face consistency, hand and hair edges, clothing lines, background distractions, and whether the image still reads well at the crop size where you will use it.

World Cup Fan Photos should be recognizable through visible details such as color, posture, card framing, scene texture, seasonal cues, supporter energy, or private keepsake mood. This is where World Cup Fan Photos becomes more than a menu label. The visible mood should explain why the category was chosen, while the private gallery keeps the customer in control of what stays personal and what becomes a downloaded favorite.

Mistakes to avoid

Avoid asking World Cup Fan Photos to cover several unrelated fan, game-day, premiere, or holiday scenes at once; the narrower theme should make review easier. The fastest way to weaken world cup fan photos results is to overload the request with unrelated goals. Do not ask one job to be a professional portrait, a themed album, a restoration pass, and a motion concept at the same time. Keep the category honest, then run a second request when the next direction is different enough to need its own review.

A planning pass before you spend credits

  • Name the exact use for the finished images.
  • Choose the clearest source photos before adding style references.
  • Match the request to World Cup Fan Photos and Sports, not every nearby category.
  • Review credit cost before generation starts.
  • Use the private gallery to compare results before downloading favorites.

Start with Headshot Generator, then compare World Cup Fan Photos with nearby categories before generating. The best choice is the one that makes the review criteria obvious before the first image is generated.

World Cup Fan Photos FAQ

World Cup Fan Photos questions usually come down to source quality, scope, credit planning, and whether the finished images match the intended use.

Is World Cup Fan Photos good for a first request?

Yes, if the intended use is clear and the source photos are current, sharp, and permission-safe. If you are testing a dramatic change, start narrower so the first private gallery can show whether the direction deserves a larger credit spend.

How many source photos should I prepare?

Use enough images to show identity, angle, and expression without adding confusion. A small set of clear portraits usually beats a large group of old, filtered, or mixed-purpose images.

When should I choose another category instead?

Choose another category when the review criteria change. If World Cup Fan Photos is being judged by a different use case, style world, or motion need, split the work into a separate private job so credits support a clearer outcome.

World Cup Fan Photos works best when it is treated as a focused planning choice. Prepare the right inputs, review the cost, and let the private gallery show what should happen next.

settings.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. MydreamShoots also uses similar browser storage, such as local storage, to keep the AI photo service secure, usable, and consistent while you move between packages, checkout, your account, and private albums.

2. Essential cookies

Essential cookies support customer sign-in, scoped sessions, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, credit reservation flows, private album access, rate limiting, fraud prevention, and secure admin or customer authentication. These cookies are required for the core service and cannot be switched off inside the site without breaking key features.

3. Preference storage

We may remember practical preferences such as menu state, recently opened workspace views, selected package context, language or display choices if available, and browser-side UI settings. This helps MydreamShoots open the right customer workspace more quickly.

4. Performance and diagnostics

We may collect limited technical signals to understand slow pages, failed requests, broken checkout steps, job submission errors, and account access issues. These signals help us improve route speed, generation reliability, and customer support.

5. Analytics and measurement

If analytics tools are enabled, they may help us understand aggregated usage such as popular package categories, tool discovery, pricing page visits, and conversion paths. Analytics should not be used to sell your uploaded photos or generated images.

6. Payment, email, hosting, and AI providers

Connected providers may set or read cookies or similar identifiers when needed for checkout, anti-fraud checks, email delivery, hosting security, media storage, or AI generation. Their use is limited to providing and protecting the requested service.

7. Your browser controls

You can block, delete, or limit cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, MydreamShoots may not be able to keep you signed in, complete checkout, reserve credits, start generation jobs, or open private albums.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add or remove providers, analytics, checkout methods, or security features. Email support@test.grownstride.com with cookie or tracking questions.

You may upload only photos, reference images, prompts, or other materials that you own or have permission to use. Do not upload minors, non-consenting people, public figures, protected marks, stolen images, or materials that violate law, platform rules, or third-party rights.

4. No AI training on your photos

Your inputs are never used to train models. 30-day auto-delete applies to input photos after generation. Private uploads and account records are protected with AES-256 at rest and TLS 256-bit in transit. Some billing, security, tax, dispute, refund, and account-integrity records may be retained where required or reasonably necessary.

5. AI output variability

AI photo results can vary based on source photo quality, pose, lighting, package settings, moderation review, provider availability, and model behavior. myDreamshoots may reject, rerun, delay, moderate, or remove jobs that violate rules or cannot be completed reliably.

6. Private albums and use of outputs

Generated images and albums are designed for private customer access unless you choose to share, publish, or download them. You are responsible for reviewing outputs before using them in advertising, profiles, documents, merchandise, social media, or other public settings.

7. Refunds and guarantee review

Refunds and credit adjustments follow the Refund Policy, including the 100% money-back guarantee when the shoot does not look like you, subject to support review, account history, and the details of the affected request.

8. Contact

Email support@test.grownstride.com for account, billing, refund, policy, or legal questions.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Use recent, sharp photos where your face is visible and not heavily filtered. A small set of varied source images usually gives the workflow more useful information than many near-duplicates.
settings.body: Good source photos do not need to be professional studio images. Natural phone photos can work well when the subject is well lit, unobstructed, and captured from several useful angles.
settings.bulletList: Use clear focus and even lighting|Include front, three-quarter, and natural-expression views|Avoid sunglasses, extreme filters, heavy blur, and cropped faces|Include wardrobe or hairstyle variety when the package calls for it

settings.question: Can I create couple or group photos?
settings.answer: Yes. Couple, friend, and group results work best when every person is clearly visible in approved source photos and the chosen package is designed for more than one subject.
settings.body: For a group set, keep the source images organized and make sure each person has given permission for the intended use. Results can vary when faces are small, hidden, or heavily overlapping.

settings.question: What can the Best AI Image page help me create?
settings.answer: The Best AI Image page helps you compare private AI image directions such as profile photos, professional portraits, creator images, seasonal albums, fashion concepts, beauty previews, product lifestyle shots, and social-ready visuals generated from approved source photos.

settings.question: How do I choose the best AI image theme for my use case?
settings.answer: Choose by destination and intent. LinkedIn headshots need a cleaner professional look, creator campaigns need expressive crops, seasonal cards need clear holiday context, and business or product images need realistic framing that matches the channel where the image will appear.

settings.question: Which source photos produce the best AI image results?
settings.answer: Use sharp, recent, well-lit photos with visible faces or subjects, natural skin detail, and minimal obstruction. Avoid heavy filters, screenshots, low-resolution crops, copyrighted references, and images of people who have not approved the intended use.

settings.question: Are AI image results private by default?
settings.answer: Generated image requests are tied to the signed-in myDreamshoots account and delivered through the private workspace or gallery. The images are not treated as a public portfolio by default, but privacy also depends on what you choose to download and share.

settings.question: Can I use generated AI images on profiles, social media, or business pages?
settings.answer: You can use suitable results when you control the source material, have permission from every person shown, follow platform rules, and include any required AI disclosure. Review commercial claims, endorsements, logos, and sensitive contexts before publishing.

settings.question: How should I review final AI images before download?
settings.answer: Check face identity, hands, teeth, eyes, text-like marks, background artifacts, clothing details, brand marks, and crop quality. Keep the strongest outputs and avoid using images that could misrepresent a person, location, product, or affiliation.

settings.question: When should I choose AI video instead of an AI image package?
settings.answer: Choose an AI image package when you need a polished still gallery. Choose an AI video workflow when the goal is motion: a short intro, animated profile concept, product teaser, album moment, or social clip that starts from a strong approved image.

settings.question: Which still image works best for AI video generation?
settings.answer: Use a clean frame with a clear subject, balanced composition, visible face or product detail, and enough background space for movement. Avoid crowded group photos, tiny faces, heavy blur, text-heavy graphics, and images with complicated hands or overlapping objects.

settings.question: Are AI video credits, format, and duration shown before generation?
settings.answer: Yes. Supported video requests show the available format, credit requirement, and workflow details before generation starts. Video generation can cost more credits than still images because motion processing is more resource intensive.

settings.question: Where do completed AI video clips appear?
settings.answer: Completed clips stay inside the private customer workspace or gallery, where you can review playback, check quality, and download the output. Keep the job reference if a video request fails or does not appear as expected.

settings.question: Can I publish AI video outputs on social media or business channels?
settings.answer: You can publish suitable clips when the source image is approved, every person shown has consented, the content follows platform rules, and any required AI disclosure is included. Review faces, motion artifacts, brand marks, and implied endorsements before posting.

The World Cup Fan Photos package category helps myDreamshoots customers choose a clear package direction before they spend credits.

When World Cup Fan Photos is the right fit

Use World Cup Fan Photos when World Cup Fan Photos and Sports are the nearest match for the next photo set. If the goal is still vague, start by naming the final use: profile update, creator album, keepsake, announcement, social draft, or a short motion test.

The strongest world cup fan photos requests keep the brief and the result aligned. A customer who needs a calm work portrait should not judge the same set by the standards of a dramatic scene package.

What to prepare before choosing it

Prepare clear approved source portraits, then add one cue that belongs to World Cup Fan Photos: light, scene texture, outfit tone, occasion, group size, or card-ready crop. Start with sharp source photos and one style cue that matters most to the package. Treat the source photos as identity evidence first. Style references, outfit notes, fan details, holiday cues, or movement ideas should support the request after the person is already clear.

For a first pass, keep the input set smaller and cleaner than a social camera roll. Use current images, avoid heavy filters, and separate unrelated goals into different private jobs. myDreamshoots can follow a focused brief more reliably than a folder that asks for several looks at once.

How to compare World Cup Fan Photos with nearby choices

Compare world cup fan photos against neighboring packages by the job it solves, not by which cover image looks strongest. The table below turns the category into a practical choice before credit cost is confirmed.

Credit and private gallery planning

Before the job starts, review the visible credit cost and ask whether the category is carrying the right amount of work. If you only need to test world cup fan photos, a smaller request can teach you what works. If the final use is already clear, a broader gallery may be easier to judge because it gives more crops and expressions to compare.

Finished outputs belong in the signed-in private gallery first. Use that space to compare identity, crop, expression, background detail, and whether the package category actually delivered the mood you selected. Download favorites only after separating public-use images from experiments.

Details to review before download

Review whether the finished images look like World Cup Fan Photos instead of drifting into a generic Sports album. Also check small visual details that often decide whether a result is ready for a profile, card, post, or archive: face consistency, hand and hair edges, clothing lines, background distractions, and whether the image still reads well at the crop size where you will use it.

World Cup Fan Photos should be recognizable through visible details such as color, posture, card framing, scene texture, seasonal cues, supporter energy, or private keepsake mood. This is where World Cup Fan Photos becomes more than a menu label. The visible mood should explain why the category was chosen, while the private gallery keeps the customer in control of what stays personal and what becomes a downloaded favorite.

Mistakes to avoid

Avoid asking World Cup Fan Photos to cover several unrelated fan, game-day, premiere, or holiday scenes at once; the narrower theme should make review easier. The fastest way to weaken world cup fan photos results is to overload the request with unrelated goals. Do not ask one job to be a professional portrait, a themed album, a restoration pass, and a motion concept at the same time. Keep the category honest, then run a second request when the next direction is different enough to need its own review.

A planning pass before you spend credits

  • Name the exact use for the finished images.
  • Choose the clearest source photos before adding style references.
  • Match the request to World Cup Fan Photos and Sports, not every nearby category.
  • Review credit cost before generation starts.
  • Use the private gallery to compare results before downloading favorites.

Start with Headshot Generator, then compare World Cup Fan Photos with nearby categories before generating. The best choice is the one that makes the review criteria obvious before the first image is generated.

World Cup Fan Photos FAQ

World Cup Fan Photos questions usually come down to source quality, scope, credit planning, and whether the finished images match the intended use.

Is World Cup Fan Photos good for a first request?

Yes, if the intended use is clear and the source photos are current, sharp, and permission-safe. If you are testing a dramatic change, start narrower so the first private gallery can show whether the direction deserves a larger credit spend.

How many source photos should I prepare?

Use enough images to show identity, angle, and expression without adding confusion. A small set of clear portraits usually beats a large group of old, filtered, or mixed-purpose images.

When should I choose another category instead?

Choose another category when the review criteria change. If World Cup Fan Photos is being judged by a different use case, style world, or motion need, split the work into a separate private job so credits support a clearer outcome.

World Cup Fan Photos works best when it is treated as a focused planning choice. Prepare the right inputs, review the cost, and let the private gallery show what should happen next.

settings.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. MydreamShoots also uses similar browser storage, such as local storage, to keep the AI photo service secure, usable, and consistent while you move between packages, checkout, your account, and private albums.

2. Essential cookies

Essential cookies support customer sign-in, scoped sessions, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, credit reservation flows, private album access, rate limiting, fraud prevention, and secure admin or customer authentication. These cookies are required for the core service and cannot be switched off inside the site without breaking key features.

3. Preference storage

We may remember practical preferences such as menu state, recently opened workspace views, selected package context, language or display choices if available, and browser-side UI settings. This helps MydreamShoots open the right customer workspace more quickly.

4. Performance and diagnostics

We may collect limited technical signals to understand slow pages, failed requests, broken checkout steps, job submission errors, and account access issues. These signals help us improve route speed, generation reliability, and customer support.

5. Analytics and measurement

If analytics tools are enabled, they may help us understand aggregated usage such as popular package categories, tool discovery, pricing page visits, and conversion paths. Analytics should not be used to sell your uploaded photos or generated images.

6. Payment, email, hosting, and AI providers

Connected providers may set or read cookies or similar identifiers when needed for checkout, anti-fraud checks, email delivery, hosting security, media storage, or AI generation. Their use is limited to providing and protecting the requested service.

7. Your browser controls

You can block, delete, or limit cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, MydreamShoots may not be able to keep you signed in, complete checkout, reserve credits, start generation jobs, or open private albums.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add or remove providers, analytics, checkout methods, or security features. Email support@test.grownstride.com with cookie or tracking questions.

3. Failed jobs and technical issues

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release reserved credits, rerun the job, troubleshoot the account, or approve a refund after review.

4. Trust commitments

  • AES-256 at rest · TLS 256-bit in transit. Encryption standards are used across the stack.
  • 100% money-back guarantee. If the shoot does not look like you, request a refund review.

5. Refund window and subscriptions

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date. If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

6. Credit history and contact

Refunds and billing reversals appear in the customer's credit history. Email support@test.grownstride.com with your account email and purchase details.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Scope of this policy

This Privacy Policy explains how MyDreamShoots handles information when customers visit www.mydreamshoots.com, create an account, upload source photos, buy credits or subscriptions, use AI photo packages, open private albums, contact support, or use connected checkout and generation tools.

2. Information we collect

We collect account information such as your email address, authentication method, session records, customer profile details, support messages, and communication preferences. We also process uploaded source photos, reference images, package selections, prompts or style choices you submit, generated previews, delivered images, albums, order records, subscription status, credit ledger events, checkout references, device signals, browser type, approximate request metadata, and security logs.

3. How we use information

MyDreamShoots uses this information to operate customer accounts, generate requested AI photo results, reserve and settle credits, deliver private albums, process checkout, detect failed jobs, provide customer support, secure the service, prevent misuse, improve reliability, test new package workflows, and show the correct pages after you sign in.

4. Uploaded photos and generated images

Your uploads and generated results are treated as private customer assets. They are connected to your signed-in account and are not sold as stock images, published in public galleries, or transferred to unrelated storefronts by default. You decide whether to download, share, or reuse your delivered images. We may temporarily process uploads and outputs with infrastructure or AI providers only to complete the service you requested.

5. Payments, credits, and checkout records

Payments may be processed by Stripe or another connected payment provider. MyDreamShoots stores order IDs, checkout status, plan names, credit purchases, credit reservations, refunds, reversals, and subscription events so your account balance remains accurate. We do not store full card numbers on our own servers.

6. Cookies and similar technology

We use cookies, local storage, and similar tools for sign-in, session security, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, preference memory, rate limiting, diagnostics, and limited analytics. See the Cookie Policy for more detail.

7. Service providers

We may use hosting, database, storage, email, analytics, payment, moderation, and AI infrastructure providers. These providers may process limited customer data only for the purpose of running, securing, generating, storing, or delivering the MyDreamShoots service.

8. Retention and deletion

Uploads, generated results, albums, order records, and credit history may remain available while your account is active so you can revisit past work. You may request deletion of uploaded or generated photos. Some billing, fraud-prevention, tax, security, dispute, and account integrity records may be retained where required or reasonably necessary.

9. Your choices

You may contact us to request access, correction, export, deletion, or help with account privacy. We may need to verify your identity or account ownership before acting on sensitive requests. Browser controls may also let you manage cookies and local storage.

10. Security

We use account-scoped sessions, private customer routes, access checks, security cookies, and operational monitoring to reduce unauthorized access. No online service can guarantee perfect security, so customers should protect their login method and contact us quickly if they suspect unauthorized account use.

11. Children

MyDreamShoots is not intended for children under the age required to consent to online services in their location. Customers should not upload photos of minors unless they have the legal right and consent to do so.

12. Changes and contact

We may update this policy as features, providers, or legal requirements change. Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, deletion, or data-use questions.

settings.question: Which Aidreamcapes occasion tool should I use?
settings.answer: Choose the tool that matches the private album moment: fan-scene atmosphere, game-day group energy, holiday cards, creator occasion portraits, premiere-inspired photos, or permission-safe content planning.

settings.question: Do tools recreate real public figures or official marks?
settings.answer: No. Aidreamcapes tools focus on original occasion atmosphere and approved source photos, not unauthorized celebrity likenesses, athlete identities, official logos, league marks, venue marks, or misleading affiliation.

settings.question: What source photos work best for occasion tools?
settings.answer: Use clear, well-lit photos with permission from every person shown. Group tools work better when faces are visible and not heavily overlapping; holiday and fan-scene tools work better when the source photos have enough detail for a private album concept.

settings.question: Are source photos and finished albums private?

settings.question: How are credits handled for Aidreamcapes tools?
settings.answer: Supported tools show the credit requirement before generation starts, reserve credits while processing, and settle or release credits according to the recorded request status. Review the cost before starting an album or motion request.

settings.question: Can I use results on social pages?
settings.answer: Yes, when every person shown approved the use, the content avoids misleading endorsement or official affiliation, and the post follows platform and AI disclosure rules.

settings.question: What should I include in an Aidreamcapes support request?
settings.answer: Include the account email, order or job reference, album direction, request time, and a short description of the issue, such as missing gallery delivery, credit question, quality concern, or failed generation.

settings.question: Where are policy rules explained?
settings.answer: Use the Privacy Policy, Content Policy, Refund Policy, Terms of Service, and Cookie Policy before uploading source photos, buying credits, or publishing album images. These pages explain privacy, acceptable content, rights, billing, and site-use rules.

settings.question: Can support review credit status?
settings.answer: Support can review visible reservation, settlement, release, failed-request, checkout, and delivery records tied to the account. Refund eligibility still depends on the applicable policy and the recorded status of the request.

settings.question: Should I send private photos through email?
settings.answer: Do not send unnecessary private photos through external channels. Provide request details first, and use the private workspace for source photos unless support asks for a specific reference.

settings.question: What if an album includes a group or fan-scene concept?
settings.answer: Make sure every person shown has approved the source photos and intended use. Avoid unauthorized public figures, official marks, protected logos, and captions that imply a real endorsement or affiliation.

settings.question: What happens if an album or motion request fails?
settings.answer: Keep the job reference and contact support if the gallery does not appear, a clip fails, or credits look incorrect. Failed provider requests can release reserved credits according to the recorded status.

settings.question: Which photos should I upload for Fan-Scene Album Builder?
settings.answer: Use permission-safe portraits or group photos with visible faces and no protected logos, official marks, or unauthorized public-figure references. settings.question: How should I write direction for Fan-Scene Album Builder?

settings.question: How are credits handled when using Fan-Scene Album Builder?

settings.question: Where do Fan-Scene Album Builder results appear?

settings.question: Which photos should I upload for Permission-Safe Photo Planner?

settings.question: How should I write direction for Permission-Safe Photo Planner?

settings.question: How are credits handled when using Permission-Safe Photo Planner?

settings.question: What should I include in an Aidreamcapes support request?
settings.answer: Include the account email, order or job reference, album direction, request time, and a short description of the issue, such as missing gallery delivery, credit question, quality concern, or failed generation.

settings.question: Where are policy rules explained?
settings.answer: Use the Privacy Policy, Content Policy, Refund Policy, Terms of Service, and Cookie Policy before uploading source photos, buying credits, or publishing album images. These pages explain privacy, acceptable content, rights, billing, and site-use rules.

settings.question: Can support review credit status?
settings.answer: Support can review visible reservation, settlement, release, failed-request, checkout, and delivery records tied to the account. Refund eligibility still depends on the applicable policy and the recorded status of the request.

settings.question: Should I send private photos through email?
settings.answer: Do not send unnecessary private photos through external channels. Provide request details first, and use the private workspace for source photos unless support asks for a specific reference.

settings.question: What if an album includes a group or fan-scene concept?
settings.answer: Make sure every person shown has approved the source photos and intended use. Avoid unauthorized public figures, official marks, protected logos, and captions that imply a real endorsement or affiliation.

settings.question: What happens if an album or motion request fails?
settings.answer: Keep the job reference and contact support if the gallery does not appear, a clip fails, or credits look incorrect. Failed provider requests can release reserved credits according to the recorded status.

settings.question: How should I choose an Aidreamcapes occasion tool?
settings.answer: Choose the tool that matches the private album moment you want to create, such as fan-scene atmosphere, game-day group energy, holiday cards, creator occasion portraits, premiere-inspired photos, or a short motion concept from an approved still image.

settings.question: Which source photos are best for occasion tools?
settings.answer: Use clear, well-lit photos with permission from everyone shown. Group tools work better with visible faces and less overlap, while motion tools usually need one strong still image with a clear subject and room for movement.

settings.question: How should I describe a fan-scene or holiday request?
settings.answer: Keep the direction original and practical: describe mood, crop, setting, colors, group size, and album use. Avoid unauthorized public-figure likenesses, official team logos, venue marks, brand logos, trademarks, or captions that imply a real endorsement.

settings.question: How do credits work for Aidreamcapes tools?
settings.answer: Supported tools show the credit requirement before an album or motion request starts. Credits can be reserved during processing and settled or released according to the recorded request status, which helps customers compare still image and motion options.

settings.question: Where are occasion tool results delivered?
settings.answer: Finished images or motion outputs stay inside the signed-in Aidreamcapes account and private gallery for review, download, and account history rather than appearing as a public listing by default.

settings.question: What should I inspect before sharing results?
settings.answer: Check subject permission, face consistency, hands, marks, captions, crops, background details, logos, AI disclosure needs, and any wording that might suggest an official relationship before posting or using an output in a campaign.

AIdreamcapes usa correo de cuenta, sesiones, fotos fuente, notas de ruta, paquete elegido, instrucciones creativas, resultados, pedidos, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y metadatos tecnicos para operar una galeria privada de viaje.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos de destino, mantener saldo y pedidos correctos, entregar galerias privadas, solucionar fallos, prevenir abuso y mejorar la orientacion de escena.

3. Fotos y rutas privadas

Las subidas y resultados permanecen asociados al sitio aidreamcapes.eu y a la cuenta iniciada. No se transfieren a otros escaparates ni se publican como muestras publicas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos los procesa un proveedor conectado. Conservamos estados de pago, ordenes, suscripciones, reservas, reversiones y reembolsos cuando es necesario para soporte, cumplimiento y seguridad.

5. Opciones del cliente

Para acceso, eliminacion, correccion o privacidad, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu e incluye email de cuenta y datos del pedido.

seo.title: Politica de reembolsos | AIdreamcapes
seo.description: Consulta el proceso de AIdreamcapes para revisar creditos de ruta, entregas incompletas y reembolsos de viaje.
seo.keywords: AIdreamcapes,politica de reembolsos,retratos de viaje,creditos de ruta,galeria privada

settings.body:
1. Elegibilidad

Las solicitudes se revisan segun uso de creditos, estado de pago, suscripcion y entrega de la galeria.

2. Creditos reservados

Si una ruta falla por un problema tecnico, soporte puede liberar la reserva, repetir el trabajo o emitir creditos de reemplazo.

3. Creditos usados

Los creditos de galerias entregadas normalmente no se reembolsan porque el procesamiento de escena ya fue consumido.

4. Calidad de fotos fuente

Fotos borrosas, baja luz, permisos insuficientes o notas contradictorias pueden limitar la elegibilidad.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu con email de cuenta, pedido y ruta afectada.

settings.body:
1. Entrega online

AIdreamcapes no gestiona envio postal. Cada retrato de viaje, reserva de creditos y archivo final queda asociado a la cuenta iniciada.

2. Acceso a la ruta

Usa el mismo correo para revisar escena, destino, progreso, resultados y descargas dentro de la galeria privada.

3. Ritmo de produccion

El tiempo puede cambiar por cola tecnica, detalle de la ruta, calidad de fotos fuente, cantidad de imagenes y revisiones automaticas.

4. Soporte de entrega

Si una ruta no aparece, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu con email de cuenta, nombre de paquete y contexto del destino.

seo.description: Terminos de AIdreamcapes para rutas visuales, retratos autorizados, creditos, pedidos y uso responsable.
seo.keywords: AIdreamcapes,terminos de servicio,retratos de viaje,creditos de ruta,galeria privada

settings.body:
1. Aceptacion

Al usar AIdreamcapes, comprar creditos, subir fotos fuente o confirmar una ruta visual aceptas estos terminos.

2. Uso permitido

Debes tener derecho sobre las fotos que subes y no solicitar escenas que vulneren privacidad, derechos de terceros, seguridad o propiedad intelectual.

3. Creditos de ruta

Los costes se muestran antes de enviar una escena. Las reservas, gastos y devoluciones se reflejan en el historial de la cuenta.

4. Entrega

Las galerias se entregan digitalmente en el espacio privado. El resultado depende de fotos fuente, direccion de destino, notas y disponibilidad tecnica.

5. Contacto

Para revisar terminos, pedidos o cuenta, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu.

settings.body:
1. Subidas permitidas

Sube retratos, referencias de vestuario, inspiracion de lugar o notas creativas sobre las que tengas derechos o permiso.

2. Contenido no permitido

No uses AIdreamcapes para suplantacion, acoso, abuso, desnudez no consentida, menores en contextos sensibles, documentos privados o fines ilegales.

3. Escenas de destino

Las rutas visuales deben describir ambientes, luz y narrativa sin reclamar ubicaciones reales falsas o permisos que no existen.

4. Revision

Podemos rechazar pedidos o retirar salidas que violen esta politica.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu para revisar una solicitud.

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamcapes usa correo de cuenta, sesiones, fotos fuente, notas de ruta, paquete elegido, instrucciones creativas, resultados, pedidos, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y metadatos tecnicos para operar una galeria privada de viaje.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos de destino, mantener saldo y pedidos correctos, entregar galerias privadas, solucionar fallos, prevenir abuso y mejorar la orientacion de escena.

3. Fotos y rutas privadas

Las subidas y resultados permanecen asociados al sitio aidreamcapes.eu y a la cuenta iniciada. No se transfieren a otros escaparates ni se publican como muestras publicas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos los procesa un proveedor conectado. Conservamos estados de pago, ordenes, suscripciones, reservas, reversiones y reembolsos cuando es necesario para soporte, cumplimiento y seguridad.

5. Opciones del cliente

Para acceso, eliminacion, correccion o privacidad, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu e incluye email de cuenta y datos del pedido.

settings.body:
1. Aceptacion

Al usar AIdreamcapes, comprar creditos, subir fotos fuente o confirmar una ruta visual aceptas estos terminos.

2. Uso permitido

Debes tener derecho sobre las fotos que subes y no solicitar escenas que vulneren privacidad, derechos de terceros, seguridad o propiedad intelectual.

3. Creditos de ruta

Los costes se muestran antes de enviar una escena. Las reservas, gastos y devoluciones se reflejan en el historial de la cuenta.

4. Entrega

Las galerias se entregan digitalmente en el espacio privado. El resultado depende de fotos fuente, direccion de destino, notas y disponibilidad tecnica.

5. Contacto

Para revisar terminos, pedidos o cuenta, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu.

settings.body:
1. Subidas permitidas

Sube retratos, referencias de vestuario, inspiracion de lugar o notas creativas sobre las que tengas derechos o permiso.

2. Contenido no permitido

No uses AIdreamcapes para suplantacion, acoso, abuso, desnudez no consentida, menores en contextos sensibles, documentos privados o fines ilegales.

3. Escenas de destino

Las rutas visuales deben describir ambientes, luz y narrativa sin reclamar ubicaciones reales falsas o permisos que no existen.

4. Revision

Podemos rechazar pedidos o retirar salidas que violen esta politica.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu para revisar una solicitud.

settings.body:
1. Continuidad de ruta

AIdreamcapes usa cookies necesarias y almacenamiento local para reconocer la sesion, conservar elecciones de destino, proteger formularios y mantener pagos o galerias de viaje en curso.

2. Diagnostico operativo

Usamos senales tecnicas acotadas para revisar rendimiento, intentos de abuso, errores de ruta, estado de credito y disponibilidad de entrega.

3. Preferencias del cliente

La gestion se realiza desde el navegador. Al desactivar cookies esenciales, algunas rutas, pagos, accesos o galerias privadas pueden dejar de funcionar.

4. Contacto

Para consultas sobre cookies de AIdreamcapes escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu.

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamcapes usa correo de cuenta, sesiones, fotos fuente, notas de ruta, paquete elegido, instrucciones creativas, resultados, pedidos, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y metadatos tecnicos para operar una galeria privada de viaje.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos de destino, mantener saldo y pedidos correctos, entregar galerias privadas, solucionar fallos, prevenir abuso y mejorar la orientacion de escena.

3. Fotos y rutas privadas

Las subidas y resultados permanecen asociados al sitio aidreamcapes.eu y a la cuenta iniciada. No se transfieren a otros escaparates ni se publican como muestras publicas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos los procesa un proveedor conectado. Conservamos estados de pago, ordenes, suscripciones, reservas, reversiones y reembolsos cuando es necesario para soporte, cumplimiento y seguridad.

5. Opciones del cliente

Para acceso, eliminacion, correccion o privacidad, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu e incluye email de cuenta y datos del pedido.

settings.body:
1. Elegibilidad

Las solicitudes se revisan segun uso de creditos, estado de pago, suscripcion y entrega de la galeria.

2. Creditos reservados

Si una ruta falla por un problema tecnico, soporte puede liberar la reserva, repetir el trabajo o emitir creditos de reemplazo.

3. Creditos usados

Los creditos de galerias entregadas normalmente no se reembolsan porque el procesamiento de escena ya fue consumido.

4. Calidad de fotos fuente

Fotos borrosas, baja luz, permisos insuficientes o notas contradictorias pueden limitar la elegibilidad.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu con email de cuenta, pedido y ruta afectada.

settings.body:
1. Entrega online

AIdreamcapes no gestiona envio postal. Cada retrato de viaje, reserva de creditos y archivo final queda asociado a la cuenta iniciada.

2. Acceso a la ruta

Usa el mismo correo para revisar escena, destino, progreso, resultados y descargas dentro de la galeria privada.

3. Ritmo de produccion

El tiempo puede cambiar por cola tecnica, detalle de la ruta, calidad de fotos fuente, cantidad de imagenes y revisiones automaticas.

4. Soporte de entrega

Si una ruta no aparece, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu con email de cuenta, nombre de paquete y contexto del destino.
